business_problem: Raylu wanted enterprise-grade pipeline discipline, follow-up automation, and revenue visibility for a lean growth team without hiring a dedicated RevOps function or slowing its AI-native way of working.
solution_summary: Raylu adopted Salesforce early as the operating core for a lean, AI-native revenue team rather than waiting until scale forced a migration. Through Salesforce Launchpad, the company plugged Salesforce directly into workflows that already run through Claude, giving a small team the depth of a larger organization without adding dedicated RevOps headcount. Salesforce automatically captures daily email and meeting history, creates follow-ups for inbound leads, and routes website demo requests into Salesforce and then Slack so the team sees the right deals at the right time. Claude acts as a control layer for onboarding, schema changes, permissions, reports, and analytics, while Salesforce- and Slack-based workflows automate billing and renewals, consolidate contract details, and surface usage metrics. The result is a revenue engine built for autonomy, clarity, and fast iteration.

solution_components.name: Salesforce Launchpad
solution_components.role: Accelerates onboarding so Raylu can adopt enterprise CRM workflows at startup speed.

solution_components.name: Salesforce
solution_components.role: Stores pipeline, activity history, workflows, and contract context for the revenue team.

solution_components.name: Claude
solution_components.role: Acts as the interface for CRM changes, answers, reporting, and automated workflow control.

solution_components.name: Slack
solution_components.role: Receives deal notifications and exposes shared revenue context to the wider team.

data_flow: Website demo requests, inbound emails, and meeting activity are captured in Salesforce, which triggers Slack alerts when deals move toward conversion. Claude sits on top of that CRM layer to answer questions, manage configuration, and automate billing and renewal workflows from shared contract and usage data.
business_outcome: Raylu improved opportunity visibility, increased pipeline coverage, captured richer deal context, and kept a small team operating like a much larger revenue organization.
metrics: 2x uplift in pipeline coverage this quarter
50 qualified funds added to future-quarter pipeline

Billing and renewals are automated with reminders, contract consolidation, and usage metrics.
